name: Analytic Single Scattering Model
definition: A real-time rendering method for participating media that captures light scattering effects (glows, diffuse shading changes) by using an explicit analytic integration of the single scattering light transport equations for an isotropic point light source in a homogeneous medium, implemented via lookup tables.
summary: The Analytic Single Scattering Model is a real-time technique that uses closed-form solutions and lookup tables to simulate volumetric glows and shading in thin fog, avoiding numerical integration.
